description: Image Description: The image displays a single, handwritten digit "2" in black ink on a white background. The digit is written in a cursive style, with a smooth, flowing stroke that begins at the top left and curves downward to form the upper loop of the "2". It then extends diagonally downward to the right, forming the lower part of the numeral. The stroke is consistent in thickness, suggesting it was drawn with a steady hand. The background is plain and uncluttered
